$description: Punch2Pen design tokens. Direction locked 2026-09-30, rebranded the same day to the founder's 2PEN logo: brick red (sampled from the logo) and a legal-yellow pad, on the Open graphite DAW chrome (plugin #21). Semantic names match the CSS variables already used by plugin/Source/ui/public/index.html and site/public/site.css. Run `node design/tokens/build.mjs` to regenerate tokens.css.

900.$description: Window / editor behind the WebView. Site page ground.

850.$description: Chrome: header, transport strip, status bar, site nav.

800.$description: Raised: pill, popover, sheet, Return to Live, inputs.

600.$description: Solid divider when alpha lines are not possible.

3.$description: Tertiary labels. Raised from shipped 0.48 so chrome labels clear 4.5:1.

4.$description: Disabled and decoration only. Never running text.

red.$description: Hue 1. 600 is the brand red, sampled from the founder's 2PEN logo (the 2 badge and the P E N letters). 300 is the same hue lifted so it reads as text on graphite. Red is a fill with white type, like the badge.

300.$description: Accent text on graphite. 6.7:1 on pane, 5.7:1 on chrome, 5.1:1 on raised.

400.$description: Display emphasis on graphite (accent-strong). AA large only.

600.$description: Brand red. Fills with white type (6.9:1), and brand ink on the legal pad (6.0:1). Decorative only on graphite (2.7:1).

rec.$description: The recording state and nothing else: the REC badge (label and pulsing dot), the header line while recording, the stream cursor, the R key hint, the sync label in REC. Never outside recording, never a fill larger than the badge, never in shaders or brand marks. Brighter and more orange than the brand red so the two never read as one.

wait.$description: Engine not connected (WAIT) and caution copy.

pad.$description: The legal pad from the founder's logo: yellow stock, blue rules. Used for lyric sheets, exports, and site moments where the words land on paper. Never inside the plugin chrome.

paper.$description: Legal yellow, sampled from the logo.

rule.$description: Blue rules, sampled from the logo. Decoration only (1.5:1).

accent.$description: Brand red on the pad: adlibs, ticks, the header rule.

shader.$description: Mid-tones only the shader presets use (design/shaders/src/presets.js). Kept here so a rebrand reaches the shaders too.

paper-shadow.$description: Paper Texture shadow under the legal pad (pad-card).

wait-mid.$description: Gem Smoke mid-tone between WAIT amber and graphite (wait-smoke).

idle-mid.$description: Gem Smoke mid-tone between ink and graphite (idle-smoke).

highlight.$description: Highlighter: legal yellow laid over words on graphite. Seek flash, dictionary words, selection.

line.$description: Underline and ring for highlighted words.

semantic.$description: Role tokens. These names are the CSS variables the plugin and site already use.

accent.$description: Accent as text, icon, or line on graphite.

accent-strong.$description: Display-size emphasis on graphite (24 px bold and up): 4.4:1 on chrome, AA large. Reads as brick where red-300 reads pink.

accent-fill.$description: Primary button and badge fill, with accent-ink type. 6.9:1.

accent-dim.$description: Red wash behind an accent icon or chip.

accent-line.$description: Border of a selected chip or shipped tag.

focus.$description: Focus ring. Ink, so focus never reads as recording.

play.$description: PLAY, LIVE, corrected. White: the pen is live. Red stays for the brand and REC.

display.$description: Site and brand headlines only. Set with font-stretch 68% and weight 800 to 900. Loaded from Google Fonts on the site. Not loaded in the plugin.

sans.$value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", sans-serif
sans.$description: UI text and lyrics. System face, no network.

mono.$description: The punch: clock, bar and beat, badges, labels.

title.$description: Active line. Scales with the editor width.

hold.$description: Highlight holds on the last sung word after the final timestamp.

past.$description: Temporal Hierarchy opacity. Unchanged from HANDOFF.md.

focal-play.$description: Active line sits 40% down the pane during playback.
